title: Google News input
description: Google News articles for search queries, topics (Business, Technology...) or locations, in any language and country, from Google's public RSS feeds. Each article: title, source, date, the publisher's real URL and the Google News link.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Words, names or brands to search in Google News, one per line. Google operators work: "exact phrase", OR, -exclude, site:reuters.com, intitle:word. Each query is one feed.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Google News sections for the chosen country: Top stories, World, Nation, Business, Technology, Entertainment, Sports, Science, Health.

locations.title: Locations (local news)
locations.description: Cities, regions or countries for local news, one per line, e.g. Chicago, Bavaria, Texas.

language.title: Language
language.description: Google News language code: en-US, en-GB, en, de, fr, es, it, pt-BR, ro, uk, pl, ja... With a country, it selects the Google News edition (e.g. language "de" + country "AT" = Austria in German).

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code of the Google News edition: US, GB, CA, AU, IN, DE, FR, ES, IT, BR, RO, MD, UA, PL, JP...

timeRange.title: Period
timeRange.description: Only articles published in this period. "Custom dates" uses Date from / Date to. Searches use Google's when:/after:/before: operators; topic and location feeds are filtered by publication date.

dateFrom.title: Date from
dateFrom.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD), only with Period = Custom dates.

dateTo.title: Date to
dateTo.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD), only with Period = Custom dates. Empty = today.

maxArticlesPerFeed.title: Max articles per query / topic / location
maxArticlesPerFeed.description: Google News gives up to ~100 articles per feed. Above 100, each search query is read day by day over the period (one request per day), which reaches thousands of articles for busy topics.

decodeUrls.title: Real article URLs
decodeUrls.description: Turn Google News redirect links (news.google.com/rss/articles/...) into the publisher's real URL. Included in the price. Off = faster, only the Google News link.

fetchPublisherDetails.title: Snippet, image and author from the publisher
fetchPublisherDetails.description: Open each article page once and read its preview metadata: description (snippet), main image, author and canonical URL. Charged as a separate event, only when details are found. The RSS feed itself has no snippet.

includeRelatedCoverage.title: Related coverage
includeRelatedCoverage.description: For top stories and topics, Google groups articles about the same story. Adds the other articles of the group (title, source, link) to each row. Free.

deduplicate.title: Skip duplicates across feeds
deduplicate.description: An article found by several queries or topics is saved (and charged) only once.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: The default Apify proxy works: Google News feeds are public. Each retry uses a new IP. The Apify RESIDENTIAL and GOOGLE_SERP groups are not available in this Actor (not needed): if selected, the run uses the default Apify proxy instead. For your own IPs, use proxy URLs.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel requests
maxConcurrency.description: Articles decoded in parallel. Keep it low (3) to stay polite and avoid rate limits.

requestDelayMs.title: Pause between feeds (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Pause between two RSS requests, in milliseconds.

maxRetries.title: Retries per request
maxRetries.description: How many times a failed request is retried on a new IP.
